adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` with no `.catch(...)`. If the destroy request fails (network/server error), the rejection is unhandled and the UI provides no explicit feedback (unlike `save()`, which `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). This is a real behavioral issue visible in the diff.
